label: MNE-BIDS
description: Convert one raw MEG/EEG/NIRS recording (.fif/.edf/.bdf/.snirf) to BIDS

external.installHint: Install Python plus mne-bids: pip install mne-bids (also installs mne). BIDSvue probes python3 / python (py on Windows). The detected interpreter path and versions are shown in the form before you convert.

fields.label: Task name
fields.help: Required. Letters and digits only. Becomes _meg.json.TaskName.

fields.label: Session
fields.help: Optional. Letters and digits only. Empty = no session layer.

fields.label: Acquisition
fields.help: Optional. Distinguishes multiple recordings with the same task / run.
